_doc: xLights input-adapter settings. Models matching any exclusion are imported but marked not controllable (with the reason), so they are reported rather than silently dropped. shadow_models: 'skip_shadow' (default, 0.20.2) leaves out models that have 'Shadow Model For' set and plans the models they shadow; 'sequence_shadow' does the opposite - plans the shadow model and leaves out the models whose channels it covers. A model with 'Active' unticked in xLights is never planned. exclude_controllers: controller names whose props are left out (empty by default: a prop on 'No Controller' - not wired yet - is planned like any other, so you see what it will get; add "No Controller" to leave such props out). exclude_models: model names to treat as not controllable (e.g. alternative props sharing channels). timing_tracks: which seqtool timing tracks the exported .xsq gets - any of sections, bars, beats, lyrics (lyrics only when imported with 'lyrics import'; empty list = none). umbrella_name_patterns: groups whose name matches one of these (regular expressions) are umbrella groups - over the others, planned as part of the yard - even when xLights lists props rather than groups in them (default: names ending in -all); a rule with group_kind= still decides for its groups. shadow_followers: models whose start channel follows a shadow model ('>Shadow:1' or '@Shadow:1'): true = treat as a shadow model too (left out with skip_shadow), false = plan it; 'layout' asks about new ones and remembers the answer here. export_on_replan: after a change (pin, react, palette ...) the plan is made again; true also writes the .xsq each time (0.24.28: by default only 'xlights-export' / 4. Export does, which saves seconds per change). rotation_clockwise (0.24.48): a 'rotation' share of a turn (3oclock, 90deg) is clockwise on the Layer Settings Rotation slider; false if your xLights turns the other way.
